name: Deceptive-NeRF/3DGS Pipeline
definition: A sparse-view reconstruction method that enhances NeRF/3DGS by continuously densifying input observations with synthetic pseudo-observations generated by a diffusion model during training.
summary: Deceptive-NeRF/3DGS is a sparse-view reconstruction method that enhances NeRF or 3DGS by generating synthetic pseudo-observations guided by an uncertainty map derived from view-consistency warping.
